title: Average Fourier coefficient of restrictions
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{−1,1\}^{n}\to\mathbb{R}$, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $S\subseteq J$. Choose uniformly a sign assignment $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$. The expected Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the restriction of $f$ obtained by fixing those coordinates to $z$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at the frequency $S$, viewed as a subset of all $n$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to the reals
A subset $J$ of the coordinate set
